title: Browse locally represented Projects and preserve exact Project detail truth

requirements.invariant: Current Project lists and details remain usable from represented synchronized local data and expose readiness whenever required Project evidence is incomplete. The application flow adds no sorting, search, card, tab, budget, media, route, or mutation semantics.

Project selection and detail identity use represented stable ProjectID and ClientID in one Account. Project and Client display names remain exact presentation text and never become relationship or selection authority.

One backend-neutral application model atomically projects active and archived rows from each validated directory snapshot, preserves upstream order and exact lifecycle semantics, exposes represented partial/stale rows, and labels empty as authoritative only when the verified projection proves it.

A represented Project can produce a detail request only through ProjectDirectoryPresentationSnapshot.selection(projectId:) followed by detailRequest(validating:) against the same current snapshot. Directory refresh never silently rebinds or reissues the request.

The selected detail continuously preserves every verified ProjectDetailHeaderPresentation state: waiting readiness, found ready/partial/stale content, incomplete, authoritative absence, unavailable, retryable cached or uncached, and required-update cached or uncached.

Directory and detail streams are continuously reactive and lifecycle-owned. Rapid reselection, restart, pre- or post-first-value failure, unexpected normal termination, spontaneous cancellation, and explicit stop cannot allow stale or post-stop evidence to mutate current state. Every source termination is observed, stop cancels and joins both still-active observations, and both normal and failed staging cleanup paths await application-model drainage before runtime close.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: LedgerTargetAppModel depends only on LedgerTargetCore. A thin target-app adapter alone may import LedgerTargetPowerSync and forward the Account-bound Project directory and exact detail watches; no provider type, raw database, SQL, credential, visibility policy, or generic backend field crosses into the application model.

Executable work is limited to the four claimed leaves and frozen staging-shell, generated Xcode project, environment-check, and conversion-control touchpoints. It adds no schema, handler, Data API grant, RLS, Sync Stream, MCP, media, migration, hosted resource, production access, Firebase change, release, or cutover authority.

items: Reuse ProjectDirectoryPresentationSnapshot, ProjectBrowsingSelection, ProjectCoreDetailsRequest, ProjectCoreDetailsUpdate, ProjectDetailHeaderPresentation, and their verified projectors without alternate identity, lifecycle, ordering, readiness, completeness, absence, or failure meanings.
The application model owns reactive directory/detail presentation, current evidence-bound selection, bounded diagnostics, and observation lifecycle only.

items: Render represented directory and detail evidence without network while preserving exact readiness, completeness, false-empty, cached-failure, unavailable, and required-update truth.
Rapid reselection and explicit stop cancel and drain obsolete observations; generation isolation prevents late evidence from mutating current state.
Cross-Account, malformed, mismatched, thrown, cancelled, or unexpectedly completed sources fail closed with bounded non-secret diagnostics.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project hero media and attachment presentation are excluded.

items: Implement a Core-only LedgerTargetAppModel application flow, a thin LedgerTargetPowerSync runtime adapter in the staging app, and a SwiftUI view driven only by typed model state.
Replace the staging shell's inline Project projection, stable-ID selection, detail observation, and associated state while preserving runtime bootstrap and Project Setup/Client creation behavior.

Expose stable source-level accessibility identifiers for directory status, active/archived counts, every segment-plus-Project row button, selected Project/Client text, detail state/readiness, and separate directory/detail diagnostics. MCP remains unchanged.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase snapshot, import, mapping, or reconciliation.

items: Expose bounded directory/detail diagnostic codes and exact local state labels without logging Project/Client names, IDs, provider payloads, SQL, endpoints, or credentials.
The flow remains in the isolated target staging app. Rollback is source reversion/local staging database disposal; Firebase and production remain unchanged.

verification.expected: One directory emission atomically produces active and archived rows with exact upstream order, duplicate-name stable identity, Project lifecycle segmentation, and active-Project visibility when its Client is archived.
Ready, partial, stale, incomplete, source-nonexhaustive, and authoritative-empty directory evidence remain distinct for both segments; initial loading is never presented as empty.

Cross-Account or malformed directory evidence and deterministic pre/post-first-snapshot throw, spontaneous cancellation, or unexpected normal completion clear prior rows/status, invoke the directory-source termination hook exactly once, and expose only bounded diagnostics without false empty or retained authority.

Selection derives one exact captured ProjectCoreDetailsRequest only from the represented current segment snapshot. Missing, opposite-segment, cross-Account, or previously captured selection evidence rejected by a refreshed snapshot dispatches no detail watch; a new explicit selection captured from the current snapshot may dispatch one.

A table-driven detail stream preserves every waiting readiness variant; found ready, partial, and stale content; every incomplete variant; authoritative absence; unavailable; retryable cached and uncached; and required-update cached and uncached state, plus multiple reactive updates without stopping after first content.
Rapid A-to-B selection cancels and drains A before observing B; late A events and directory refresh cannot mutate or silently rebind B, while a subsequent explicit selection uses current evidence.

Stopping before first evidence and while both directory and detail observations remain active completes within bounded time, cancels and joins both observations, receives both source-termination callbacks, prevents post-stop mutation, and preserves restart generation isolation.

The AppModel imports only Core, the app adapter alone imports PowerSync, inline Project projection/detail ownership is absent, required source-level accessibility identifiers are present, and both staging destinations compile. No interactive accessibility claim is made without UI tests.

The exact reviewed READY commit changes only comment scaffolds and synchronized control/evidence artifacts, passes all three immutable jobs, and leaves executable application/provider/schema/MCP/Firebase behavior unchanged.
